caption: The drawing depicts a round, lidded basket with intricate patterns. The main body of the basket has a chevron pattern in alternating colors of light brown, tan, red, blue, and purple, arranged in zigzag lines that encircle the entire container. The lid is also decorated: its top features a central, square motif bordered in red with intersecting lines and smaller diamond shapes in tan, purple, and green tones. The rim of the lid displays vertical segments and small rectangular blocks in shades of light brown and beige. The overall color palette consists primarily of earthy tones with occasional accents of brighter blue, red, and purple. The basket is drawn on a plain beige background, and the square border around the basket drawing is slightly darker than the rest of the paper. There are no other objects or elements, and the focus is entirely on the decorative woven container.
title: Basket
